scripts.dev:ollama: sh -c "curl -sSf http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'Ollama already running on 127.0.0.1:11434' || (command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1 && ollama serve || { echo 'Ollama not installed; skipping local Ollama startup.'; exit 0; })"
scripts.dev:all: sh -c "pnpm run dev:web & WEB_PID=$!; pnpm run dev:company-system & DB_PID=$!; pnpm run dev:ollama & OLLAMA_PID=$!; trap 'kill $WEB_PID $DB_PID $OLLAMA_PID 2>/dev/null' INT TERM EXIT; wait $WEB_PID; STATUS=$?; kill $DB_PID $OLLAMA_PID 2>/dev/null || true; wait $DB_PID 2>/dev/null || true; wait $OLLAMA_PID 2>/dev/null || true; exit $STATUS"
